teaser: Know the Reach was made with AI and by a person: Silvio Switha, whose twenty years as a musician shaped every choice. AI changed the speed, not the vision.
core_idea: RiskMandate's song Know the Reach and its video were made with AI by Silvio Switha, a musician, singer and producer, who directed every part of them: the lyrics' chorus, structure and pacing, and hundreds of variations. AI made him a producer with immediate feedback, doing at a start-up's budget what produced projects always did; the version he chose is worth more because people connect with the story and the people behind it, and the loop closes when his band records it.

quotes.text: And every hour he spent is twenty years of experience
The tool amplifies what you bring to it.
But the value of this version goes up, because it is the version Silvio chose and curated.
